_meta.description: Label classification database for DSP longevity research. Five tiers: major, major_indie, services, indie, self_released. Master ownership tracked separately from distribution tier.

tiers.major: Owned/operated by UMG, Sony, or Warner Music Group
tiers.major_indie: Artist-owned label with major distribution deal — nominal independence, major economics
tiers.services: Management/services company with distribution function — not a traditional label
tiers.self_released: No label, distributed via aggregator (DistroKid, TuneCore, Gamma., etc.)

OVO Sound.notes: Drake's imprint — Warner distribution, artist retains masters

pgLang.notes: Services/creative company model — not a traditional label. Co-founded with Dave Free.

Dreamville Records.notes: Co-owned with Interscope. Cole retains creative control, masters split.

GOOD Music.notes: Ye's imprint — historically Def Jam distributed. Relationship status with UMG volatile post-2022.

XO Records.notes: The Weeknd's own label through Republic/UMG

Rimas Entertainment.notes: True independent Latin label. Bad Bunny's label — one of the most successful indie operations in music.

Gingerbread Man Records.notes: Sheeran's own label — Atlantic distribution, he owns masters

Roc Nation.notes: Management, touring, sports agency, and music services. Not a traditional label — acts as services company. Distribution varies per artist deal.

Gamma..notes: Artist-friendly distribution company competing with DistroKid at scale. Artists keep ~85-100% of revenue. Formerly Apple Music executive Larry Jackson.
artists: varies — distribution service not exclusive label

Vydia.notes: Acquired by Gamma. — video and music distribution for independent artists

Top Dawg Entertainment.notes: TDE — Kendrick pre-pgLang, SZA, ScHoolboy Q. Artists own publishing but TDE holds masters in most deals.

SALXCO.notes: Steve Lacy's production/creative company — Sony distribution

Homemade Projects.notes: Noah Kahan's own imprint through Republic — retains masters

Half Orange Records.notes: Zach Bryan's own label — Warner distribution deal, artist owns masters. Highly publicized indie deal.

Big Loud Records.notes: Morgan Wallen's label — Sony Nashville distribution

Back Blocks Music.notes: Luke Combs' own imprint through Columbia Nashville

Schoolboy Records.notes: Post Malone's own imprint through Republic

Cactus Jack Records.notes: Travis Scott's imprint through Epic/Sony. Scott owns masters.

DistroKid.notes: Largest music distribution platform by volume. Flat annual fee, artist keeps 100% of royalties. Spotify owns minority stake.

TuneCore.notes: Owned by French indie major Believe. Per-release fee model.

HYBE America.notes: BTS and K-pop acts US operations. HYBE is publicly traded Korean entertainment conglomerate.

Rose Avenue.notes: Bieber's own imprint post-Def Jam deal renegotiation

Taylor Swift.label: Taylor Swift / Republic Records
Taylor Swift.notes: Re-recorded albums (Taylor's Version) fully owned by Swift. Original masters owned by Ithaca Holdings (Scooter Braun, sold to Shamrock Capital). New releases on Republic with artist owning masters.

Beyoncé.label: Parkwood Entertainment
Beyoncé.notes: Parkwood is Beyoncé's own company — Columbia distribution. Full creative and master ownership.

Frank Ocean.label: Boys Don't Cry
Frank Ocean.notes: Fully independent since leaving Def Jam. Distributed Blonde independently, owns all masters.

Chance the Rapper.label: Independent
Chance the Rapper.notes: Pioneer of streaming-only self-released model. Has since signed traditional deals but pioneered independent streaming.

Sabrina Carpenter.label: Island Records
Sabrina Carpenter.notes: Island Records / UMG. Standard major deal.

Olivia Rodrigo.label: Geffen Records
Olivia Rodrigo.notes: Geffen/Interscope deal. Historically also Happier than Ever LLC for some publishing.

SZA.label: Top Dawg Entertainment
SZA.notes: TDE holds masters, RCA/Sony distribution. SZA's deal structure has been source of public tension.

Morgan Wallen.label: Big Loud Records
Morgan Wallen.notes: Big Loud / Sony Nashville. One of country's highest-grossing artists.

Drake.label: OVO Sound
Drake.notes: OVO Sound through Warner. Drake owns masters on recent releases.

Kendrick Lamar.label: pgLang
Kendrick Lamar.notes: pgLang services model with UMG. Kendrick owns masters.

Bad Bunny.label: Rimas Entertainment
Bad Bunny.notes: Rimas is a true independent — no major deal. Most successful independent Latin operation in history.

Ella Langley.label: Mercury Nashville
Ella Langley.notes: Mercury Nashville / UMG. Standard major Nashville deal.

Noah Kahan.label: Homemade Projects / Republic
Noah Kahan.notes: Own imprint through Republic — owns masters.

Zach Bryan.label: Half Orange Records
Zach Bryan.notes: Highly publicized deal where Bryan retained master ownership — landmark for country music independence.

Travis Scott.label: Cactus Jack Records
Travis Scott.notes: Cactus Jack through Epic. Scott owns masters.

BTS.label: HYBE / Big Hit Music
BTS.notes: HYBE publicly traded Korean entertainment company. US distribution through Columbia/UMG.

KATSEYE.label: HYBE America / Geffen
KATSEYE.notes: HYBE America joint venture with Geffen Records.

Tyla.label: Epic Records
Tyla.notes: Epic Records / Sony. South African artist signed to major.

Bruno Mars.label: Aftermath / Atlantic
Bruno Mars.notes: Atlantic Records / Warner. Long-tenured major deal.

Ye.label: GOOD Music
Ye.notes: Post-UMG split, Ye distributes independently or through smaller deals. Highly volatile label situation.
